credits._personalMessage1: Hi! We're Clément and Suzon, the creators of Another Door.
credits._personalMessage2: We have devoted three years of our lives to creating this game.
credits._personalMessage3: And we wanted to thank once again everyone who helped us finish this game.
credits._personalMessage4: Your support throughout this adventure has been incredible.
credits._personalMessage5: Creating a game about betrayal and broken friendships is pretty ironic...
credits._personalMessage6: When you consider just how well-supported we are.
credits._personalMessage7: We've been lucky enough to meet some extraordinary people.
credits._personalMessage8: And this adventure will remain forever etched in our memories and in our lives.
credits._personalMessage9: Honestly, it was much harder than we expected.
credits._personalMessage10: And we're incredibly lucky and grateful to have made it this far.
credits._personalMessage11: And once again, it wouldn't have been possible without you.
credits._personalMessage12: Take care of yourselves and your loved ones.

demo._biomeEnd1: Dear viewers, just think about it... they did it! They walked through that door!
demo._biomeEnd2: As you know, [yellow1]Another Door[/c] is a pilot episode. Or a DEMO, as some call it.
demo._biomeEnd3: And the production team has plenty more surprises in store for you!
demo._biomeEnd4: Monsters, new tokens, more effects, crazy moons, and above all... more doors.
demo._biomeEnd5: Like the door to the [yellow1]City of Faded Roses[/c] or the door to the [yellow1]Blind Mountains[/c]!
demo._biomeEnd6: To find out all about it, you'll have to come back in a little while with your "friends"!

narrator._introduction_1: Is this thing on? Can you hear me?
narrator._introduction_2: ONE, TWO, ONE, TWO, MICROPHONE TEST.
narrator._introduction_3: I see our viewers are ready. Hello, plebs, you're looking lovely today!
narrator._introduction_4: Welcome to this new episode of [yellow1]Another Door[/c], the show where trust is currency and traitors reign supreme.
narrator._introduction_5: Please give a warm welcome to...
narrator._introduction_7: (Could you refresh my memory, I forgot my little cards, who are you exactly?)
narrator._introduction_8: Ah! I'm being told in my earpiece that our players are finally ready. Give them a big round of applause!
narrator._introduction_9: They're so bad they could die during the tutorial... We're glad to have you with us, {0}!
narrator._introduction_10: They're the kind of player who knows which colour pencil tastes best. Welcome, {0}!
narrator._introduction_11: Today is not their day, and tomorrow doesn't look any better. Here's {0}!
narrator._introduction_12: They've always been told that the most important thing is to participate. Do your best {0}!
narrator._introduction_13: Like every night in [yellow1]Another Door[/c], the winner will be the player who has collected the most gems at the end of the [yellow1]3 rounds[/c].
narrator._introduction_14: Today, our participants are competing to win this magnificent... [yellow1]RED TRICYCLE[/c]!
narrator._introduction_15: A priceless prize that everyone would love to own!
narrator._introduction_16: But enough chatter, let's get on with the [yellow1]first round[/c]!
narrator._introduction_17: Let's find out right now how many monsters are hiding behind this door...
narrator._introduction_18: Wow, [yellow1]{0} monsters[/c]! This is going to be reaaally tough!
narrator._introduction_19: If you're a coward and decide not to face them, you can go through the [blue1]EXIT DOOR[/c].
narrator._introduction_20: You will exit this round permanently and your gems will be secured. They will be added directly to your final score!
narrator._introduction_21: If you choose [blue1]ANOTHER DOOR[/c]... You agree to take on the challenge, and with it the chance to win more gems!
narrator._introduction_22: Every door you open and every monster you defeat has the potential to yield increasingly valuable loot.
narrator._introduction_23: Don't forget, you can only secure your rewards by taking the [blue1]EXIT DOOR[/c]. If you die before you get there, [yellow1]everything's lost[/c]!
narrator._introduction_2_2: This first round promises to be thrilling! And it will continue as long as at least one surviving player chooses [blue1]ANOTHER DOOR[/c]!
narrator._gameEnd1: [yellow1]{0}[/c] you are THE winner of today's show. Congratulations!
narrator._gameEnd2: With the modest sum of [yellow1]{0} gems[/c], you crushed the competition.
narrator._gameEnd3: And as promised, you're walking away with this magnificent... [yellow1]RED TRICYCLE[/c]!
narrator._gameEnd4: But did you really think the point of this show was to win?
narrator._gameEnd5: No. The real goal was you. Your behavior. Your decisions.
narrator._gameEnd6: Who you are when no one is watching. And what happened?
narrator._gameEnd7: You lied. Manipulated. Acted out of pure selfishness.
narrator._gameEnd8: I'm not judging. The world is cruel. People are awful. Friendships are fleeting.
narrator._gameEnd9: You're right to be terrified. That's how we survive: by crushing, dominating, betraying.
narrator._gameEnd10: And if you're hungry for glory, even at the expense of your "friends", you have nothing to feel guilty about.
narrator._gameEnd11: Because you followed the rules. Just like everyone before you...
narrator._gameEnd13: In any case, thank you for watching episode [yellow1]{0}[/c] of [yellow1]Another Door[/c], dear viewers!
narrator._gameEnd14: Thus the cycle of hatred endures!
narrator._turnLeftSingle: Only [yellow1]{0}[/c] round to go. {1} is in the lead!
narrator._turnLeftPlural: Only [yellow1]{0}[/c] rounds to go. {1} is in the lead!
narrator._runNext: End of round. Let's start again.
narrator._tutorialReplay1: Well, perhaps the game is "a little" rigged. Please accept my insincere apologies.
narrator._tutorialReplay2: I just wanted to make sure you understood the rules of the game and agreed to my terms.
narrator._tutorialReplay7: I had actually asked for the casting process to be a bit more selective.
narrator._tutorialReplay9: The next player who makes the right choice is an idiot.
narrator._tutorialReplay13: Actually, the rules of the game state:
narrator._tutorialReplay14: "The decisions made by participants, even if they are perceived as irrational or puzzling in light of theoretical expectations, must be preserved in their entirety..."
narrator._tutorialReplay15: "This methodological requirement responds to a fundamental imperative: to guarantee the fidelity of the experimental protocol to spontaneous decision-making processes, a sine qua non condition for understanding the mechanisms underlying social interactions..."
narrator._tutorialReplay16: "Any interference in these choices, motivated by a desire for rationalization after the fact, would introduce interpretive distortions that could alter the validity of behavioral inferences drawn from the experiment..."
narrator._tutorialReplay17: Experience? Did I say experiment? You must have misheard. Of course, I'm talking about [yellow1]Another Door[/c], the famous TV game show!
narrator._tutorialReplay18: To think that one of your "friends" made you buy this game by saying: "You'll see, we'll have a lot of fun!"
narrator._tutorialReplay19: Perhaps if I offer you another choice, you'll agree to submit?
narrator._tutorialReplay20: You're tough negotiators, I like that.
narrator._tutorialReplay21: The value of a soul is measured by the strength of its convictions, I have always known this.
narrator._tutorialReplay22: Would you kindly continue this little game?
narrator._tutorialReplay23: Meanwhile, some of your "friends" must really think you're the village idiot.
narrator._tutorialReplay24: This is my final offer. What does your greed say?
narrator._tutorialReplay27: Do you realize that the translation budget for [yellow1]Another Door[/c] has just skyrocketed simply because you're sitting there pressing the same button over and over again?
narrator._tutorialReplay28: You act like robots stuck in an endless loop, but translators, on the other hand, have a soul... And a bank account to fill. Keep it up, they love it.
narrator._tutorialDamage1: Ooooh! A wild and ferocious creatu...
narrator._tutorialDamage2: Who left the training dummy lying around?
narrator._tutorialDead1: Can someone from production remove this pile of straw?
narrator._tutorialVoteDead1: What do you mean, "the game is rigged"? Of course not...
narrator._tutorialVoteDead2: Unfortunately for you, the dead can't influence the course of the game...
narrator._tutorialVoteDead3: No luck. You'll have to wait for the next round.
narrator._biomeEnd2: Our participants survived all the doors of [yellow1]{0}[/c]! That's impressive. Very impressive!
narrator._biomeEnd3: But with [yellow1]Another Door[/c], there are more surprises in store!
narrator._biomeEnd4: Ladies and gentlemen... here is the [yellow1]{0}[/c]!
narrator._noMoreDoor1: Oh. Um... I think we're out of doors.
narrator._noMoreDoor2: So that's the end of the round!
